```ts
type AnonymousExtraRoute = {
  method: HttpRouteMethod;
  path: string;
  entry: "anonymous";
  handler: (c: Context<any, any>, deps: AnonymousExtraRouteDeps) => Response | Promise<Response>;
};
type AnonymousExtraRouteDeps = {
  app: Hono<any, any>;
  registry: Registry;
  systemQuery: (type: string, payload: unknown, tenantId: TenantId) => Promise<unknown>;
  write: (type: string, payload: unknown) => Promise<WriteResult>; // Runs as the session the /api chain resolved for this request — anonymous when no token is sent, the authenticated user otherwise.
  clientIp: string; // Resolved by the server's single trustedProxyHops-aware resolver — never read X-Forwarded-For yourself.
};
type ExtraRouteDefinition = AnonymousExtraRoute | UserExtraRoute | SignatureExtraRoute<unknown>;
type RoleDispatchArgs = SystemDispatchArgs & {
  roles: string[];
};
type SignatureExtraRoute<TVerified> = {
  method: HttpRouteMethod;
  path: string;
  entry: "signature";
  verify: (request: SignatureExtraRouteVerifyRequest, deps: SignatureExtraRouteVerifyDeps) => Promise<TVerified>;
  handler: (c: Context<any, any>, verified: TVerified, deps: SignatureExtraRouteDeps) => Response | Promise<Response>;
};
type SignatureExtraRouteDeps = {
  app: Hono<any, any>;
  registry: Registry;
  secrets?: SecretsContext;
  systemQuery: (type: string, payload: unknown, tenantId: TenantId) => Promise<unknown>;
  dispatchSystemWrite: (args: SystemDispatchArgs) => Promise<WriteResult>; // Privilege scope: SystemAdmin of the target tenant, WITHOUT the route's access check — only reachable because verify() has already proven the caller's authenticity (signature, HMAC state, etc.).
  dispatchSystemQuery: (args: SystemDispatchArgs) => Promise<unknown>;
  dispatchWriteAs: (args: RoleDispatchArgs) => Promise<WriteResult>; // Same trust as dispatchSystemWrite, but runs as the tenant's system user with the "system" role plus exactly `roles` (no SystemAdmin), so the write passes app-role access checks.
};
type SignatureExtraRouteVerifyDeps = {
  registry: Registry;
  secrets?: SecretsContext;
};
type SignatureExtraRouteVerifyRequest = {
  rawBody: string;
  headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>>; // Lowercase header names — Hono/undici normalize incoming headers to lowercase, verify() must not have to re-normalize per provider.
  params: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  query: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
};
type SystemDispatchArgs = {
  handlerQn: string;
  payload: unknown;
  tenantId: TenantId;
};
type UserExtraRoute = {
  method: HttpRouteMethod;
  path: string;
  entry: "user";
  handler: (c: Context<any, any>, deps: UserExtraRouteDeps) => Response | Promise<Response>;
};
type UserExtraRouteDeps = {
  app: Hono<any, any>;
  registry: Registry;
  user: SessionUser;
  query: (type: string, payload: unknown) => Promise<unknown>;
  write: (type: string, payload: unknown) => Promise<WriteResult>;
};
```

```ts
  entityName: string;
  entityId: string | null;
  initialValues?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>; // Previously saved extension values for the entity (passed through from the loaded detail row).
  screenId?: string; // Set only in the list-header slot (`entityId` is null): the list's `screen.id`, so a header control can access the per-screen URL filter state (`useListUrlState`) — for example, a tag filter that narrows the list to a set of IDs.
  filterParams?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>; // Set only in a Dashboard-`custom` panel: the currently selected value of the screen filter (see DashboardFilterDefinition), merged as with any other panel query.
  values?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>; // Current form values of the host RenderEdit (controlled mode) — same snapshot reference as `RenderEditChangeState.values`.
  patch?: (partial: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) => void; // Sets host RenderEdit form values from outside (e.g. a VIN-decode roundtrip that fills other fields) — same function as `RenderEditControls.patch`, merges only the given keys.
  validate?: () => boolean; // Validates the host form without writing — same function as `RenderEditControls.validate`; field errors land in `snapshot.errors` on the field instead of a collective message.
  markSaved?: (fields?: string[]) => void; // Marks host form values as saved after the section wrote them itself, so a following navigation does not ask to discard.
  hasUnsavedChanges?: boolean; // Whether the host form has unsaved changes.
  wizardStep?: {
    index: number;
    isLast: boolean;
  }; // Current wizard step, only set for `layout.mode === "wizard"` forms.
  reportStepComplete?: (complete: boolean) => void; // Only set for extension steps of a `layout.mode: "wizard"` entityEdit editing an existing record (update mode); undefined everywhere else.
};
```

```ts
type DataTableListNotice = "truncated" | "searchTruncated"; // `truncated`: more groups than the server answers.
type DataTableMeasure = { // One server-computed measure; a money measure holds one minor-unit value per currency.
  field: string;
  kind: ListAggregateMeasureKind;
  value: ListAggregateValue;
};
type DataTableRangeBound = "min" | "max";
type DataTableRangeFacet = { // "From/to" inputs on a number field.
  field: string;
  label: string;
  min: string;
  max: string;
  unit?: string; // Shown after the inputs, e.g. the money field's currency.
};
type DataTableServerGroup = {
  key: string; // `relatedListGroupKey` of the group value; stable across reloads.
  value: AggregateKey; // Raw group value, rendered through the group column when `label` is absent.
  label?: string;
  count: number; // Rows of the whole group on the server, not the loaded ones.
  measures: DataTableMeasure[];
  collapsed: boolean;
  rowCount: number; // How many of the table's `rows` belong to this group; rows arrive in group order.
  hasMore: boolean;
  loading: boolean;
};
type DataTableServerGroups = { // Server-side grouping: groups are the load unit, each loads its own rows.
  field: string;
  groups: DataTableServerGroup[];
  totalCount: number;
  onToggle: (key: string) => void;
  onLoadMore: (key: string) => void;
  onHeaderVisible: (key: string) => void;
};
type DataTableTotals = {
  measures: DataTableMeasure[];
};
```

## packages/renderer/src/data-table-bulk-types.ts

```ts
type BulkRowOutcome =
  | {
    kind: "succeeded";
  }
  | {
    kind: "failed";
    message: string;
  }
;
type DataTableBulk = {
  actions: DataTableBulkAction[];
  reload: () => Promise<void>; // Reloads the list once after a run.
};
type DataTableBulkAction = {
  id: string;
  label: string; // Translated label of the underlying row action.
  style?: "primary" | "secondary" | "danger";
  icon?: IconKey;
  confirmText?: (count: number) => string; // Present: one confirm dialog for the whole selection, with this text for `count` rows.
  confirmLabel?: string;
  appliesTo: (row: ListRowViewModel) => boolean; // False: the row action's `visible` hides it for this row; the run skips the row.
  writeRow: (row: ListRowViewModel) => Promise<BulkRowOutcome>; // Exactly one server write for one row.
};
```

## packages/renderer/src/data-table-facet-types.ts

```ts
type DataTableDateRangeFacet = {
  field: string; // The facet's namespace (its date field) — a key, not a filter value.
  label: string; // Translated label ("When").
  from: string;
  to: string;
};
type DataTableFacet = {
  field: string; // Entity-Feldname (= URL-State-Key + payload.filters[].field).
  label: string; // Translated Button-Label ("Status", "Active").
  options: { value: string; label: string; }[]; // Selectable values with display labels.
  chips?: DataTableFacetChip[]; // Present: render the facet as a row of single-choice toggle chips instead of a dropdown.
  showCounts?: boolean; // Chips only: show each chip's `count` next to its label.
  hideEmpty?: boolean; // Chips only: hide chips whose `count` is 0 (unless pressed).
  onSearchChange?: (query: string) => void; // Present: the options come from a server-side search (reference facets), so the dropdown shows a search field and reports the typed term instead of filtering `options` itself.
  searching?: boolean; // The search is loading; the option list may still show the previous term's rows.
};
type DataTableFacetChip = {
  id: string;
  label: string; // Translated chip label.
  values: string[]; // Selection a click sets; `[]` clears the facet.
  count?: number; // Matching row count, undefined while unknown.
};
```

## packages/renderer/src/data-table-view-types.ts

```ts
type DataTableColumnPin = ListColumnPin;
type DataTableColumnPins = Readonly<Record<string, DataTableColumnPin>>;
type DataTableColumnWidths = Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
type DataTableDensity = ListTableDensity;
type DataTableExport = { // What the export button sends to POST /api/export/xlsx (xlsx is the only format).
  screen: string; // Screen QN `<feature>:screen:<id>`.
  screenShortId: string;
  payload: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>; // The list payload without paging keys; the server reads the whole filtered list.
  columns: string[]; // Visible column ids in display order.
};
type DataTableGroupByChoice = {
  value: string; // Active group field, "" = not grouped.
  fields: string[];
  onChange: (next: string) => void;
};
type DataTableResetAll = {
  active: boolean; // True while something deviates from the screen default.
  onReset: () => void;
};
type DataTableTableBlock = { // The DataTable props a screen's `table` block feeds.
  view?: DataTableViewOptions; // View menu (column picker, density); absent = no menu.
  resetAll?: DataTableResetAll; // Replaces the facet reset with one that also covers sort, search and page size.
  exportList?: DataTableExport; // Present: the toolbar has an export button (web only).
  compactHeader?: boolean; // Smaller (12px) semibold header row.
  serverGroups?: DataTableServerGroups; // Present: the rows are grouped on the server; replaces pager and infinite scroll.
  totals?: DataTableTotals; // Present: a footer row with the server-computed totals of the filtered list.
  notice?: DataTableListNotice; // Present: the toolbar says the answer is incomplete and asks to narrow the list.
  rangeFacets?: DataTableRangeFacet[];
  onRangeChange?: (field: string, bound: DataTableRangeBound, value: string) => void;
};
type DataTableViewColumn = { // One column in the view menu.
  field: string;
  visible: boolean;
};
type DataTableViewOptions = {
  columns?: DataTableViewColumn[]; // Present: the view menu has a column section (visibility + order).
  onColumnsChange?: (next: DataTableViewColumn[]) => void;
  density: DataTableDensity;
  onDensityChange?: (next: DataTableDensity) => void; // Present: the view menu has a density section.
  pins?: DataTableColumnPins; // Present: pinning is on and the view menu has a pin section.
  onPinsChange?: (next: DataTableColumnPins) => void;
  widths?: DataTableColumnWidths; // Present: resizing is on.
  minWidths?: DataTableColumnWidths; // Present together with `widths`; every column has an entry (px).
  onWidthChange?: (field: string, width: number, others?: DataTableColumnWidths) => void; // `others` holds the displayed widths of the columns that had no entry yet, so they keep their size once the layout turns fixed.
  keyboardNavigation?: boolean;
  groupBy?: DataTableGroupByChoice; // Present: the view menu has a "group by" section.
  viewIsDefault: boolean; // False once columns, order or density differ from the screen default.
  onViewReset: () => void;
};
```

## packages/renderer/src/embedded-list-types.ts

```ts
type EmbeddedListCellType = "text" | "number" | "boolean" | "date" | "money" | "decimal" | "select" | "reference" | "timestamp" | "images" | "files"; // Cell type for one column of an embedded-list field.
type EmbeddedListColumn = { // One column of an embedded-list table (one entry per key of the source EmbeddedFieldDef's `schema`).
  field: string;
  label: string;
  type: EmbeddedListCellType;
  required: boolean;
  derived: boolean; // Read-only, value supplied by the caller (already computed from sibling cells) — not directly user-editable.
  readOnly?: boolean; // Shown but not editable by the user; unlike `derived` it is not computed.
  hiddenInCard?: boolean; // Phone cards skip this column; the table still shows it.
  cardLimits?: {
    min: string;
    max: string;
  }; // Phone cards show the row's min/max (sub-field names) as a hint under this column's control.
  cardAttachedTo?: string; // Phone cards render this column unlabeled beside the named column's control.
  options?: string[]; // Only for `type: "select"`.
  optionLabels?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  display?: "radio" | "dropdown"; // Only for `type: "select"`; `"radio"` renders segmented buttons, the default is a dropdown.
  referenceOptions?: { value: string; label: string; }[]; // Only for `type: "reference"` — pre-fetched by the caller, ONE query per column shared across every row (not one query per cell).
  referenceLoading?: boolean;
  optionTones?: Readonly<Partial<Record<string, SelectOptionTone>>>; // Only for `type: "select"`; tone per option (selected segment, derived badge).
  capture?: "user" | "environment"; // Only for `type: "images" | "files"`.
  maxCount?: number;
  accept?: string[];
  isHiddenInRow?: (row: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) => boolean; // Per-row state, evaluated by the caller (conditions are engine logic the primitive must not import).
  isRequiredInRow?: (row: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) => boolean;
  isDerivedInRow?: (row: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) => boolean; // Overrides `derived` per row: a conditional derived cell is editable on rows where it does not apply.
};
type EmbeddedListInputProps = { // Row-array + totals table for a `createEmbeddedListField` (invoice- positions-style) field — structurally too different from `Input`'s value/onChange union to fit there, so it's its own primitive, same as `DataTable`.
  id: string;
  columns: EmbeddedListColumn[];
  rows: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>[];
  totals?: EmbeddedListTotal[];
  currency?: string; // Currency for money cells and the totals row — one value for the whole list (currency lives on the head aggregate, not the row).
  disabled?: boolean; // Whole-list read-only (e.g. a released invoice) — hides row-mutation affordances and disables every cell.
  fixedRows?: boolean; // Rows are fixed: no add, remove, duplicate or move; cells stay editable.
  minItems?: number;
  maxItems?: number;
  uploadTarget?: {
    entityType: string;
    fieldName: string;
    entityId?: string;
  }; // Upload target of file cells: `entityType`/`entityId`/`fieldName` of the list, the column name is the `subField`.
  listIssues?: FieldIssue[]; // Shown under the whole list (e.g. under the totals row).
  rowIssues?: Readonly<Record<number, FieldIssue[]>>; // Keyed by row index.
  cellIssues?: Readonly<Record<string, FieldIssue[]>>; // Keyed `${rowIndex}.${field}`.
  onCellChange: (rowIndex: number, field: string, value: unknown) => void;
  onAddRow: () => void;
  onRemoveRow: (rowIndex: number) => void;
  onDuplicateRow: (rowIndex: number) => void;
  onMoveRow: (fromIndex: number, toIndex: number) => void;
  onPasteCells?: (rowIndex: number, columnIndex: number, grid: (string[])[]) => void; // Tab/newline-delimited clipboard paste starting at (rowIndex, columnIndex) — parsed to a 2D string grid by the Web impl (paste events are a browser-only concept); undefined caller = no paste handling wired up.
  addLabel: string;
  actionsLabel: string; // Accessible name of the (otherwise headerless) row-actions column.
  removeLabel: string;
  duplicateLabel: string;
  moveUpLabel: string;
  moveDownLabel: string;
  emptyLabel: string;
  emptyCtaLabel: string;
  testId?: string;
};
type EmbeddedListTotal = { // One entry of an embedded-list totals row (e.g. an invoice's total amount, summed across all rows by the caller).
  field: string;
  label: string;
  value: number;
  money?: boolean; // Set for labelled multi-column totals, which have no single column to read the money type from.
};
```

## packages/renderer/src/headless/dispatcher/types.ts

```ts
type BatchResult =
  | {
    isSuccess: true;
    results: WriteResult[];
  }
  | {
    isSuccess: false;
    error: DispatcherError;
    failedIndex: number;
    results: WriteResult[];
  }
;
type Command = {
  type: string;
  payload: unknown;
};
type Dispatcher = {
  write<TData = unknown>(type: string, payload: unknown, opts?: WriteOpts): Promise<WriteResult<TData>>;
  query<TData = unknown>(type: string, payload: unknown, opts?: QueryOpts): Promise<QueryResult<TData>>;
  batch(commands: Command[], opts?: WriteOpts): Promise<BatchResult>;
  stream<TChunk = unknown>(type: string, payload: unknown, opts?: StreamOpts): AsyncGenerator<TChunk, void, undefined>;
  statusStore: Store<DispatcherStatus>;
  pendingWrites(): PendingWrite[];
  pendingFiles(): PendingFile[];
};
type DispatcherError = {
  code: string;
  httpStatus: number;
  i18nKey: string;
  i18nParams?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
  message: string;
  details?: { fields?: FieldIssue[]; } & Record<string, unknown>;
  docsUrl?: string;
  requestId?: string;
};
type DispatcherStatus = "online" | "offline" | "syncing";
type PendingFile = {
  id: string;
  fileName: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
  queuedAt: string;
  attempts: number;
  progress?: number;
  lastError?: DispatcherError;
};
type PendingWrite = {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: unknown;
  queuedAt: string;
  attempts: number;
  lastError?: DispatcherError;
};
type QueryOpts = {
  signal?: AbortSignal;
};
type QueryResult<TData = unknown> =
  | {
    isSuccess: true;
    data: TData;
  }
  | {
    isSuccess: false;
    error: DispatcherError;
  }
;
type StreamOpts = {
  signal?: AbortSignal;
};
type WriteOpts = {
  requestId?: string;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
};
type WriteResult<TData = unknown> =
  | {
    isSuccess: true;
    data: TData;
  }
  | {
    isSuccess: false;
    error: DispatcherError;
  }
;
```

## packages/renderer/src/headless/form/types.ts

```ts
type FieldConditionPredicate<TValues extends FormValues, TCtx> = (values: TValues, ctx: TCtx) => boolean;
type FieldConditionValue<TValues extends FormValues, TCtx> = boolean | FieldConditionPredicate<TValues, TCtx>;
type FieldConditions<TValues extends FormValues, TCtx = unknown> = {
  visible?: FieldConditionValue<TValues, TCtx>;
  readonly?: FieldConditionValue<TValues, TCtx>;
  required?: FieldConditionValue<TValues, TCtx>;
};
type FieldState = {
  visible: boolean;
  readonly: boolean;
  required: boolean;
};
type FormController<TValues extends FormValues> = {
  getSnapshot(): FormSnapshot<TValues>;
  subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void;
  setField<K extends keyof TValues>(key: K, value: TValues[K]): void;
  setValues(partial: Partial<TValues>): void;
  clearErrors(path?: string): void;
  setErrors(errors: Readonly<Record<string, FieldIssue[]>>): void;
  validate(scope?: FormScopeKey<TValues>[]): boolean;
  reset(): void;
  rebase(): void;
  rebaseFields(fields: string[]): void;
  seedField(field: string, value: unknown): void;
  setCtx(ctx: unknown): void;
  submit<TData = unknown>(): Promise<SubmitResult<TData>>;
};
type FormControllerOptions<TValues extends FormValues, TCtx = unknown> = {
  initial: TValues;
  schema?: ZodType;
  fields?: Readonly<Record<string, FieldConditions<TValues, TCtx>>>;
  ctx?: TCtx;
  submit?: SubmitConfig<TValues>;
};
type FormScopeKey<TValues extends FormValues> = (keyof TValues & string) | `${keyof TValues & string}.${string}`;
type FormSnapshot<TValues extends FormValues> = {
  values: TValues;
  initial: TValues;
  changes: Partial<TValues>;
  isDirty: boolean;
  isUnchanged: boolean;
  errors: Readonly<Record<string, FieldIssue[]>>;
  fields: Readonly<Record<string, FieldState>>;
};
type FormValues = Record<string, unknown>;
type SubmitConfig<TValues extends FormValues = FormValues> = {
  dispatcher?: Dispatcher;
  type: string;
  payloadMode?: SubmitPayloadMode;
  stripEmptySeeds?: boolean; // Only applies to payloadMode "values".
  omitFields?: string[]; // Top-level payload keys removed right before dispatch, for fields that are shown or validated but must not reach the write handler.
  buildPayload?: (snapshot: FormSnapshot<TValues>) => unknown;
  serverFieldPathPrefix?: string;
  validateScope?: string[]; // Restricts submit()'s internal validate() call to these field names — same contract as validate()'s `scope` param.
};
type SubmitPayloadMode = "values" | "changes";
type SubmitResult<TData = unknown> =
  | ({ validationBlocked: false; isNoOp?: boolean; } & WriteResult<TData>)
  | {
    validationBlocked: true;
    isSuccess: false;
  }
;
```

```ts
type CellLink = { // Where a cell's text links to.
  href: string;
  onPress: () => void;
};
type CellLinkItem = { // One entry of a multi-reference cell: its label, linked when the target is readable.
  id: string;
  label: string;
  link?: CellLink;
};
type EditFieldViewModel = {
  field: string;
  label: string;
  type: string;
  value: unknown;
  visible: boolean;
  readOnly: boolean;
  required: boolean;
  span?: number;
  renderer?: FieldRenderer;
  options?: string[]; // Set for `type: "select"` and `type: "multiSelect"` — the allowed values.
  optionLabels?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>; // Set for `type: "select"` and `type: "multiSelect"` — translated labels per option, keyed by raw value.
  selectOptionsQuery?: {
    query: string;
    payload: OptionsQueryPayload;
  }; // Set for `type: "select"` when SelectFieldDef.optionsQuery is set: the renderer loads the options from this query (`{ rows: { value, label, description?, group?
  selectOptionsAvailabilityQuery?: {
    query: string;
    payload: OptionsQueryPayload;
  }; // Set for `type: "select"` / `"multiSelect"` when optionsAvailabilityQuery is set: the renderer loads `{ rows: { value, disabled?, hint?
  display?: "checkboxes" | "dropdown" | "radio"; // Set for `type: "multiSelect"` when MultiSelectFieldDef.display is "checkboxes" — the renderer shows a checkbox grid with a select-all toggle instead of the default combobox dropdown.
  optionTones?: Readonly<Partial<Record<string, SelectOptionTone>>>; // `type: "select"` only: tone per option, shown on the selected radio segment.
  columns?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4; // Set for `type: "multiSelect"` when MultiSelectFieldDef.columns is defined — column count for the checkbox grid at the widest breakpoint.
  maxRows?: number; // Set for `type: "multiSelect"` when MultiSelectFieldDef.maxRows is defined — grid rows visible before the checkbox grid becomes scrollable.
  multiline?: boolean | { rows?: number; }; // For `type: "text"`, set when TextFieldDef.multiline is true — the renderer then renders a textarea instead of a single-line input.
  format?: "email" | "url" | "phone" | "password" | "month" | "iban"; // From TextFieldDef.format — `password` makes the renderer mask the input.
  autoComplete?: string; // From TextFieldDef.autoComplete — HTML autocomplete token for the text input.
  writeOnly?: true; // From TextFieldDef.writeOnly — value is `true` (set) / `null` (empty), never plaintext.
  sensitive?: true; // From the field's `sensitive: true` — the value must not leave the form (drafts, URL prefill).
  wallClock?: boolean; // Only set for `type: "timestamp"` when TimestampFieldDef.locatedBy exists — wall-clock time without offset.
  min?: string; // Only for `type: "date" | "timestamp"` — date bounds (ISO) and format/locale override from the FieldDefinition.
  max?: string;
  dateLocale?: string;
  grouping?: boolean; // Only for `type: "number"` — mirrors `NumberFieldDef.grouping` (default `true`).
  refEntity?: string; // Only set for `type: "reference"`.
  refFeature?: string; // Only set for `type: "reference"` — name of the feature the referenced entity lives in.
  refLabelField?: string; // Only set for `type: "reference"` — which field of the referenced entity appears as the display label in the dropdown.
  refOptionsQuery?: string; // Only for `type: "reference"` — query handler QN the picker sources its options from, replacing the referenced entity's list handler.
  refMultiple?: boolean; // Only for `type: "reference"` — multi mode: the value is a UUID array, the renderer mounts a multi-combobox with tags.
  accept?: string[]; // Only for `type: "file" | "image"` — allowed extensions/MIME (e.g. ["jpg","png"]) + max size ("5mb").
  maxSize?: string;
  maxCount?: number; // Only for `type: "files" | "images"` — upper bound on list length.
  entityType?: string; // Only for `type: "file" | "image"` — entity name + field name for the upload POST (`/api/files`), so the endpoint can check maxSize/accept against the right field def.
  uploadActionForm?: string; // Only for file fields of an actionForm — the screen QN the upload POST names as `actionForm` instead of `entityType`; the server resolves the field through that screen.
  fieldName?: string;
  fileDisplay?: "list" | "dropzone"; // Only for `type: "files" | "images"` — how the field is shown.
  entityId?: string; // Record being edited (update mode only).
  imageVariant?: string; // Only for `type: "image"` and `"images"` — the variant name the preview requests (`/api/files/:id/variant/:name`) instead of the original.
  capture?: "environment" | "user"; // Only for `type: "image"` — forwarded to the file input's `capture` attribute so a phone opens the camera instead of the file picker.
  icon?: FieldIconKey; // Closed FieldIconKey from EditFieldSpec.icon (FIELD_ICONS registry).
  placeholder?: string; // From EditFieldSpec.placeholder, already translated — hint shown while the input is empty.
  prefix?: FieldAffix; // From EditFieldSpec.prefix / suffix.
  suffix?: FieldAffix;
  fillAction?: FieldFillAction; // From EditFieldSpec.fillAction, `label` already translated.
  embeddedListCells?: EmbeddedListCellViewModel[]; // Only set for an embedded-LIST field (`multiple: true`) — the per-cell metadata the renderer needs to draw each column/cell.
  embeddedListMinItems?: number; // Minimum row count for the embedded list.
  embeddedListMaxItems?: number; // Maximum row count for the embedded list.
  embeddedListDerived?: Readonly<Record<string, EmbeddedDerivedCellDef>>; // Sub-field name → how to compute its cell from other sub-fields of the same row.
  embeddedListTotals?: (string | { label: string; from: string[]; })[]; // Footer totals: a sub-field name, or a labelled sum of several.
  embeddedListFixedRows?: boolean; // No add, remove, duplicate or move; cells stay editable.
  embeddedListUploadTarget?: {
    entityType: string;
    fieldName: string;
    entityId?: string;
  }; // Where photos of a row's file cells are uploaded: the entity and the top-level list field; the cell name travels as `subField`.
  embeddedListCurrency?: string; // Currency for the whole embedded list's money cells and totals row — currency lives on the head aggregate (EntityDefinition.defaultCurrency), not per row.
  currency?: string; // Only set for a plain (non-list, non-embedded) `type: "money"` field — same source as embeddedListCurrency (EntityDefinition.defaultCurrency, falls back to "EUR").
  unit?: string | { field: string; }; // Only set for `type: "number"` when NumberFieldDef.unit is set — a static suffix string, or a sibling-field reference the renderer resolves against the live row values.
};
type EmbeddedListCellViewModel = {
  field: string;

  required: boolean;

  requiredWhen?: Exclude<FieldCondition, boolean>;
  options?: string[]; // Only for `type: "select"`.

  capture?: "user" | "environment"; // Only for `type: "images" | "files"`.
  maxCount?: number;
  accept?: string[];
  optionLabels?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;

  readOnly?: boolean; // Cell is shown but not editable (`EditFieldSpec.embeddedList.readOnlyCells`).
  hiddenInCard?: boolean; // Not shown on phone cards (`EditFieldSpec.embeddedList.cardHiddenCells`).

  }

;
type ListColumnViewModel = {

  linkItemsFor?: RuntimeCellLinkItems;

  optionLabels?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>; // Only for `type: "select"` or `type: "multiSelect"` — translated option labels keyed by raw value.
  optionTones?: Readonly<Partial<Record<string, SelectOptionTone>>>; // Only for `type: "select"` — declared tone per raw option value.

  id: string;

};
type RuntimeCellLink = (value: unknown, row?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) => CellLink | undefined; // Runtime-only like RuntimeRenderer; undefined means the cell stays plain text.
type RuntimeCellLinkItems = (value: unknown, row?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) => CellLinkItem[] | undefined; // Runtime-only like RuntimeCellLink; undefined means the cell uses its single renderer.
type RuntimeRenderer = (value: unknown, row?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) => string;
type Translate = (key: string, params?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) => string;
```

```ts
type ActionMenuItemSpec = { // One item in an `ActionOverflowMenu` (header/row actions beyond the primary one collapse into this menu instead of a wall of buttons).

  disabled?: boolean;
  loading?: boolean; // Render a spinner instead of the children.
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "danger" | "link" | "danger-ghost" | "ghost"; // Semantic class — default="primary".
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "icon"; // Size—default="md".
  ariaLabel?: string; // Accessible label—required for icon-only buttons (when children contain only an icon or character), otherwise the button has no accessible name.
  title?: string; // Tooltip — rendered as the `title` attribute.
  pressed?: boolean; // Toggle state for toggle buttons — web sets `aria-pressed`; leave unset for plain buttons.
  expanded?: boolean; // Disclosure state for buttons that open a menu or panel — web sets `aria-expanded`.
  width?: "full" | "auto"; // Width—default="auto" (content width).
  testId?: string;
  className?: string; // Layout extras, merged via cn().
  ref?: Ref<HTMLButtonElement>; // DOM ref on the button — escape hatch for cases that need more than a click (e.g. binding a drop-target handler).
  icon?: NavIconKey; // Icon before the label.
  iconEnd?: NavIconKey; // Icon after the label (e.g. "Continue →").
  dataAttributes?: DataAttributes;
};
type CardOptions = { // Card-Options — Verhalten/Optik, ebenfalls additiv erweiterbar.
  padded?: boolean; // Body-Padding (px-6 py-6).
  radius?: "lg" | "xl"; // Eckenradius.
  footerBordered?: boolean; // Separates the footer with `border-t` and `bg-muted/30`.
  footerInset?: boolean; // Footer horizontal padding.
  fillHeight?: boolean; // Joins the ancestor fillHeight flex chain — a tabs-mode relatedList table sizing to the panel instead of the page — instead of normal document-flow height.
  framed?: boolean; // false drops border, background, shadow and radius but keeps padding and header slots — a panel inside a host surface such as a tab panel.
  screenBody?: boolean; // The card is the whole screen body (secretMint reveal and done phase): no frame, the shared screen insets and width of form screens, children stacked with a gap.
};
type CardSlots = { // Card slots are named content regions, all optional.

  title?: ReactNode;
  subtitle?: ReactNode;
  headerContent?: ReactNode; // Free-form block content in its own full-width row below the title/subtitle/`headerActions` row, within the same header block — for a host-supplied header (projectionDetail `slots.header`).
  headerActions?: ReactNode; // Right-aligned header slot, for example a range switcher, filter, or badge.
  footer?: ReactNode; // Footer content, separated by a top border; aligned to the right by default.
};
type ConfigCascadeViewProps = { // Cascade view for a config-edit field: one origin line ("Set for this tenant", "Uses the default", …), a reset action for an own value, and a disclosure listing every level.
  cascade: ConfigCascade;
  screenScope: ConfigScope;
  onReset?: (key: string, scope: ConfigScope) => void;
  qualifiedKey?: string;
  required?: boolean; // The key declares `required: true` — a missing value reads "Not set.
  renderValue?: (value: string | number | boolean) => ReactNode; // Display form of a level value (e.g. a select's label instead of its raw value).
};

  hidden: boolean;

  children: ReactNode;
};
```

```ts
type EntityCrudHandlerDefaults = Omit<EntityHandlerOptions, "access"> & {
  access?: AccessRule;
};
type EntityCrudVerb = "create" | "update" | "delete" | "restore" | "list" | "detail";
type EntityHandlerOptions = {
  access: AccessRule;
  description?: string;
  agent?: AgentHandlerHints;
  escapeHatch?: EscapeHatchDeclaration; // Lifts row filtering for this ONE handler across every tenant instead of the caller's own — for a SystemAdmin-only operator handler over an otherwise tenant-scoped entity.
};
type EntityQueryHandlerOptions = EntityHandlerOptions;

  excludeFields?: string[]; // Fields this handler never writes.
};

  write?: EntityCrudHandlerDefaults;
  read?: EntityCrudHandlerDefaults;
  verbs?: Partial<Record<EntityCrudVerb, boolean>>;
  verbAccess?: Partial<Record<EntityCrudVerb, AccessRule>>; // Per-verb access override — falls back to `write.access`/`read.access` when unset for a verb.
  descriptions?: Partial<Record<EntityCrudVerb, string>>; // Per-verb `description` — the author writes one sentence per verb; the AI-agent manifest exposes only the verbs described here (fail-closed, same rule as hand-written handlers).
  agents?: Partial<Record<EntityCrudVerb, AgentHandlerHints>>; // Per-verb agent hints; win over `write.agent`/`read.agent`, so one irreversible verb (e.g. a hard delete) can be `risk: "high"` without raising create/update.

  registerEntity?: boolean; // Default true.
};
```

```ts
type PhasedHook<TFn> = HookOwner & {
  fn: TFn;
  phase: HookPhase;
};
type PostDeleteBatchHookFn = (payloads: DeleteContext[], context: HandlerContext) => Promise<void>;

type PostSaveBatchHookFn = (results: SaveContext[], context: HandlerContext) => Promise<void>;
type SearchPayloadContributorFn = (args: { entityName: string; entityId: EntityId; state: Record<string, unknown>; }) => Record<string, unknown> | Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
```

## packages/types/src/http-route.ts

```ts
type HttpRouteDefinition = {
  method: HttpRouteMethod; // HTTP method — mounted in Hono via app.{get,post,...}(path).
  path: string; // URL path (Hono pattern, e.g. "/feed.xml" or "/og/:tenantId.png").
  anonymous: boolean; // true = public, no session required.
  handler: HttpRouteHandler; // Hono handler.
  rateLimit?: HttpRouteRateLimit; // Enforced before the route's guards through the server's rate-limit resolver (fail-open like the global L1 limiter: a limiter outage lets the request through, counted and logged).
};
type HttpRouteHandler = (c: Context<any, any>, deps: HttpRouteHandlerDeps) => Response | Promise<Response>;
type HttpRouteHandlerDeps = { // Dependencies provided to the handler by the framework.
  app: Hono<any, any>; // The Hono app — the handler can use app.fetch(...) to call internal routes (e.g. /api/query with the full auth/anonymous chain).
  systemQuery: (type: string, payload: unknown, tenantId: TenantId) => Promise<unknown>; // Run a query handler in-process, forcing a SPECIFIC tenant — WITHOUT going through the public /api/query HTTP layer (no header parsing, no anonymousAccess tenant resolution).
  clientIp: string; // Caller IP resolved via the server's configured, trustedProxyHops-aware resolver (same one requestIdMiddleware uses for `/api/*`) — a route handler needing the caller's IP (rate limiting, audit) should read this instead of parsing X-Forwarded-For itself, which trusts whichever hop count the deployment actually has in front of it.
};
type HttpRouteMethod = "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH" | "DELETE" | "HEAD" | "OPTIONS"; // Subset of HTTP methods actively supported.
type HttpRouteRateLimit = Omit<RateLimitOption, "per"> & { // Same shape as a handler's `rateLimit`, restricted to the IP-keyed buckets: a route has no dispatcher identity to key on.
  per: "ip" | "ip+handler";
};
```

## packages/types/src/kms-adapter-types.ts

```ts
type KmsAdapter = LocalKeyKmsAdapter | RemoteCryptoKmsAdapter;
interface KmsAdapterBase {
  createKey(subject: SubjectId, ctx: KmsContext): Promise<void>; // Creates a fresh subject key.
  eraseKey(subject: SubjectId, ctx: KmsContext): Promise<void>; // Erases the key material immediately; the tombstone row stays for the audit trail.
  health(): Promise<KmsHealth>; // Probe for boot + readiness.
}
interface KmsContext {
  tenantId?: TenantId;
  requestId: string;
  userId?: string;
  eraseReason?: string;
}
interface KmsHealth {
  ok: boolean;
  latencyMs: number;
  details?: Record<string, unknown>;
}
interface LocalKeyKmsAdapter extends KmsAdapterBase {
  capabilities: {
    mode: "local-key";
  };
  getKey(subject: SubjectId, ctx: KmsContext): Promise<SubjectDek>; // Throws KeyErasedError after eraseKey (callers render "[[erased]]"), KeyNotFoundError when the subject never had a key (typically a bug).
}
interface RemoteCryptoKmsAdapter extends KmsAdapterBase {
  capabilities: {
    mode: "remote-crypto";
  };
  encrypt(subject: SubjectId, plaintext: Uint8Array, ctx: KmsContext): Promise<Uint8Array>;
  decrypt(subject: SubjectId, ciphertext: Uint8Array, ctx: KmsContext): Promise<Uint8Array>; // Same error contract as LocalKeyKmsAdapter.getKey.
}
type SubjectDek = Buffer;
type SubjectId =
  | {
    kind: "user";
    userId: string;
  }
  | {
    kind: "tenant";
    tenantId: TenantId;
  }
  | {
    kind: "record";
    entity: string;
    id: string;
  }
;
```

```ts
type ContainsSecret<T, Depth extends unknown[] = [ ]> = [ T ] extends [ never ] ? false : unknown extends T ? false : Depth["length"] extends MaxSecretDepth ? false : T extends Secret<unknown> ? true : T extends Primitive ? false : T extends SafeLeaf ? false : T extends (infer U)[] ? ContainsSecret<U, [ ...Depth, unknown ]> : T extends object ? true extends { [K in keyof T]-?: ContainsSecret<T[K], [ ...Depth, unknown ]>; }[keyof T] ? true : false : false;
type KeyScope = {
  tenantId?: TenantId;
};
interface MasterKeyProvider {
  wrapDek(dek: Buffer, scope?: KeyScope): Promise<{ encryptedDek: Buffer; kekVersion: number; }>;
  unwrapDek(encryptedDek: Buffer, kekVersion: number, scope?: KeyScope): Promise<Buffer>;
  currentVersion(): number;
  isAvailable(): Promise<boolean>;
}
type MaxSecretDepth = 8;
type Primitive = string | number | boolean | bigint | symbol | null | undefined;
type SafeLeaf = Date | RegExp | Temporal.Instant | Temporal.ZonedDateTime | Temporal.PlainDate | Temporal.PlainDateTime | Temporal.PlainTime | Temporal.PlainYearMonth | Temporal.PlainMonthDay | Temporal.Duration | Map<unknown, unknown> | Set<unknown>;
type Secret<T = string> = {
  [SecretBrand]: true;
  reveal: () => T;
};
type SecretAuditContext = {
  userId: string;
  handlerName: string;
};
type SecretKeyRef =
  | string
  | {
    name: string;
  }
;
interface SecretsContext {
  withRunner(runner: DbRunner): SecretsContext;
  get(tenantId: TenantId, key: SecretKeyRef, auditCtx?: SecretAuditContext): Promise<Secret<string> | undefined>;
  has(tenantId: TenantId, key: SecretKeyRef): Promise<boolean>;
  set(tenantId: TenantId, key: SecretKeyRef, value: string, opts?: { redact?: (plaintext: string) => string; hint?: string; updatedBy?: string; }): Promise<void>;
  delete(tenantId: TenantId, key: SecretKeyRef, opts?: { deletedBy?: string; }): Promise<boolean>;
}
```

## packages/types/src/step.ts

```ts
type EventMatch = {
  version: 1;
  expr: EventMatchExpr;
};
type EventMatchExpr =
  | {
    kind: "and";
    nodes: EventMatchExpr[];
  }
  | {
    kind: "or";
    nodes: EventMatchExpr[];
  }
  | {
    kind: "atom";
    path: string[];
    op: EventMatchOp;
  }
;
type EventMatchOp =
  | {
    kind: "eq";
    value: EventMatchValue;
  }
  | {
    kind: "ne";
    value: EventMatchValue;
  }
  | {
    kind: "in";
    values: EventMatchValue[];
  }
  | {
    kind: "gt";
    value: number | string;
  }
  | {
    kind: "gte";
    value: number | string;
  }
  | {
    kind: "lt";
    value: number | string;
  }
  | {
    kind: "lte";
    value: number | string;
  }
;
type EventMatchValue = string | number | boolean | null;
type PipelineBuildCtx<TPayload = unknown, TAwaits extends Record<string, AwaitedEventType> = Record<string, AwaitedEventType>> = { // Argument bundle passed to the closure inside `stepsPipeline(closure)`.
  event: WriteEvent<TPayload>;
  r: StepBuilder;
  awaits: TAwaits;
};
type PipelineDef<TPayload = unknown, _TData = unknown, TAwaits extends Record<string, AwaitedEventType> = Record<string, AwaitedEventType>> = { // What `stepsPipeline(closure)` returns.
  __kind: "pipeline";
  awaits?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  build: (ctx: PipelineBuildCtx<TPayload, TAwaits>) => StepInstance[];
};
type StepBuilder = { // Step-builder namespace handed to the pipeline closure.
  step: StepNamespace;
};
type StepDef<TArgs = unknown, TResult = unknown> = {
  kind: StepKind;
  defaultFailureStrategy: StepFailureStrategy;
  resultKey?: (args: TArgs) => string | undefined;
  subPaths?: string[];
  tier?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  run: (args: TArgs, ctx: PipelineCtx) => Promise<TResult> | TResult;
};
type StepFailureStrategy = "throw"; // Per-step error strategy.
type StepKind = string; // The kind discriminator for a step instance — matches the step's registration name in the step-registry (e.g. "return", "compute", "aggregate.create").
type StepNamespace = { // The collection of step factory functions.
  return: <TData>(resolver: StepResolver<WriteResult<TData>>) => StepInstance;
  compute: <TResult>(name: string, fn: (ctx: PipelineCtx) => TResult) => StepInstance;
  unsafeProjectionUpsert: (args: { table: unknown; on: string[]; row: StepResolver<Record<string, unknown>>; }) => StepInstance;
  unsafeProjectionDelete: (args: { table: unknown; where: StepResolver<WhereObject>; }) => StepInstance;
  read: {
    findOne: (name: string, opts: { table: unknown; where: StepResolver<WhereObject | undefined>; unsafeAllTenants?: { reason: string; }; }) => StepInstance;
    findMany: (name: string, opts: { table: unknown; where?: StepResolver<WhereObject | undefined>; limit?: number; unsafeAllTenants?: { reason: string; }; }) => StepInstance;
  };
  aggregate: {
    create: (name: string, opts: { executor: EventStoreExecutor; data: StepResolver<Record<string, unknown>>; }) => StepInstance;
    update: (name: string, opts: { executor: EventStoreExecutor; id: StepResolver<EntityId>; changes: StepResolver<Record<string, unknown>>; version?: StepResolver<number | undefined>; skipOptimisticLock?: boolean; }) => StepInstance;
    appendEvent: (args: { aggregateId: StepResolver<string>; aggregateType: string; type: string; payload: StepResolver<unknown>; headers?: StepResolver<Readonly<Record<string, string | number | boolean>>>; }) => StepInstance;
  };
  branch: (args: { if: StepResolver<boolean>; onTrue: StepInstance[]; onFalse?: StepInstance[]; }) => StepInstance;
  forEach: <TItem = unknown>(args: { over: StepResolver<TItem[]>; as: string; do: StepInstance[]; concurrency?: 1; }) => StepInstance;
  webhook: {
    send: (args: { url: StepResolver<string>; method?: "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH"; headers?: StepResolver<Readonly<Record<string, string>>>; body?: StepResolver<unknown>; auth?: { kind: "bearer"; secret: string; } | { kind: "header"; name: string; sec…;
  };
  mail: {
    send: (args: { to: StepResolver<string | string[]>; subject: StepResolver<string>; body: StepResolver<string>; from?: StepResolver<string>; mode: "deferred"; }) => StepInstance;
  };
  callFeature: (name: string, opts: { handler: string; payload: StepResolver<unknown>; as?: SessionUser; }) => StepInstance;
  wait: (args: { for: StepResolver<string>; }) => StepInstance;
  waitForEvent: (args: { event: AwaitedEventType; match?: StepResolver<EventMatch>; timeout: StepResolver<string>; }) => StepInstance;
  retry: (args: { times: number; backoff: "exponential" | "linear"; do: StepInstance[]; }) => StepInstance;
};
```

## packages/types/src/tenant-db-types.ts

```ts
type CrossTenantReads = Pick<TenantDb, "selectMany" | "fetchOne" | "count">;
type GlobalReads = {
  selectMany<T = Record<string, unknown>>(where?: WhereObject, options?: SelectOptions): Promise<T[]>;
  fetchOne<T = Record<string, unknown>>(where: WhereObject): Promise<T | undefined>;
};
type GlobalTableDb<TTable> = GlobalReads & (TTable extends Writable ? GlobalWrites : unknown);
type GlobalWrites = {
  insertOne<T = Record<string, unknown>>(values: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<T | undefined>;
  updateMany<T = Record<string, unknown>>(set: Record<string, unknown>, where: WhereObject): Promise<T[]>;
  deleteMany(where: WhereObject): Promise<void>;
};
type TenantDbMode = "tenant" | "system"; // TenantDb scope modes: - "tenant" (default): SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE filtered by tenantId + reference data (tenantId=SYSTEM_TENANT_ID).
type TenantDbNonWrites = {
  tenantId: TenantId;
  mode: TenantDbMode;
  unsafeRaw(): DbRunner; // Unfiltered DbRunner escape hatch for handlers/hooks that declare `escapeHatch: { reason }`.
  global<TTable extends (SchemaTable | EntityTableMeta) & TenancyBrand<"global">>(table: TTable): GlobalTableDb<TTable>; // Reach a "global" table with the tenant filter lifted — reads always work; writes reject unless the write handler declared `escapeHatch: { reason }`.
  selectMany<T = Record<string, unknown>>(table: SchemaTable | EntityTableMeta, where?: WhereObject, options?: SelectOptions): Promise<T[]>;
  fetchOne<T = Record<string, unknown>>(table: SchemaTable | EntityTableMeta, where: WhereObject): Promise<T | undefined>;
  count(table: SchemaTable | EntityTableMeta, where?: WhereObject): Promise<number>;
  advisoryXactLock(namespace: number, key: string): Promise<void>; // Transaction-scoped advisory lock keyed on (namespace, this handle's tenantId + key); released at commit or rollback.
  databaseNow(): Promise<Date>; // Postgres `now()`; inside a transaction this is the transaction start.
  aggregate(table: SchemaTable | EntityTableMeta, spec: AggregateSpec, where?: WhereObject): Promise<AggregateRow[]>;
  upsert<T = Record<string, unknown>>(table: WritableTable, values: Record<string, unknown>, options: TenantDbUpsertOptions): Promise<T | undefined>;
};
type TenantDbUpsertOptions = {
  conflictTarget: string[];
  update?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
type TenantDbWrites<TTable> = {
  insertOne<T = Record<string, unknown>>(table: TTable, values: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<T | undefined>;
  updateMany<T = Record<string, unknown>>(table: TTable, set: Record<string, unknown>, where: WhereObject): Promise<T[]>;
  deleteMany(table: TTable, where: WhereObject): Promise<number>;
};
```

## packages/types/src/tz-context.ts

```ts
type Clock = { // Source of "now" for ctx.tz; tests inject a fixed or advancing one.
  now: () => Temporal.Instant;
};
type LocatedTimestampJson = {
  at: string; // Wall-clock ISO without offset, e.g. "2026-04-03T10:00:00"
  tz: string; // IANA zone, e.g. "Europe/Lisbon"
};
type TzContext = {
  tenant: string; // Default TZ of the tenant (from tenant.timezone, default "UTC").
  user: string; // Display TZ of the current user (profile override, fallback tenant).
  now(): Temporal.Instant; // Current moment as UTC instant.
  nowIn(tz: string): Temporal.ZonedDateTime; // Current moment as ZonedDateTime in the requested zone.
  today(tz: string): Temporal.PlainDate; // Today's calendar date in the requested zone.
  todayRange(tz: string): { start: Temporal.Instant; end: Temporal.Instant; }; // Day boundaries (00:00 to 24:00 next day) as UTC instants — for DB range queries.
  parse(wallClock: string, tz: string): Temporal.ZonedDateTime; // Wall-clock string + IANA zone → ZonedDateTime.
  toInstant(zdt: Temporal.ZonedDateTime): Temporal.Instant; // ZonedDateTime → UTC instant.
  toLocatedJson(zdt: Temporal.ZonedDateTime): LocatedTimestampJson; // ZonedDateTime → JSON pair { at, tz } (API boundary).
  fromLocatedJson(obj: LocatedTimestampJson): Temporal.ZonedDateTime; // JSON pair { at, tz } → ZonedDateTime (wall-clock + IANA).
  fromCoordinates(coords: GeoCoordinates): Promise<string>; // Geo coordinates → IANA zone via the configured GeoTzProvider.
  fromAddress(address: GeoAddress): Promise<string>; // Postal address → IANA zone via GeoTzProvider.
};
```

## packages/types/src/websocket-route.ts

```ts
type WebSocketConnection = {
  send: (data: WebSocketMessageData) => void;
  close: (code?: number, reason?: string) => void;
  signal: AbortSignal; // Aborts when the socket closes.
};
type WebSocketMessageData = string | Uint8Array;
type WebSocketRouteConnectDeps = {
  user: SessionUser;
  query: (type: string, payload: unknown) => Promise<unknown>;
  write: (type: string, payload: unknown) => Promise<WriteResult>;
  clientIp: string; // Resolved via the server's trustedProxyHops-aware resolver, like HttpRouteHandlerDeps.clientIp.
};
type WebSocketRouteDefinition = {
  path: string; // Must start with "/api/ws/"; `:param` segments allowed, no "*".
  maxMessageBytes?: number; // Per-message cap; oversized messages close the socket with 1009.
  maxConnectionsPerUser?: number; // Concurrent sockets per user and tenant on this route (per server process).
  connect: (c: Context<any, any>, deps: WebSocketRouteConnectDeps) => WebSocketSessionHandlers | Response | Promise<WebSocketSessionHandlers | Response>; // Runs after auth + origin checks, before the upgrade.
};
type WebSocketSessionHandlers = {
  onOpen?: (connection: WebSocketConnection) => void | Promise<void>; // May still be awaiting when onClose runs; see `WebSocketConnection.signal`.
  onMessage?: (data: WebSocketMessageData, connection: WebSocketConnection) => void | Promise<void>;
  onClose?: (code: number, reason: string, connection: WebSocketConnection) => void | Promise<void>; // Runs immediately on close, not queued behind a slow onMessage; pending messages never start after it.
};
```

## packages/types/src/where-clause-types.ts

```ts
type OrderByClause = {
  col: string;
  direction?: "asc" | "desc";
};
type WhereOperator = {
  gt?: unknown;
  gte?: unknown;
  lt?: unknown;
  lte?: unknown;
  ne?: unknown;
  in?: unknown[];
  notIn?: unknown[]; // Not for jsonb columns; an empty list matches every row.
  like?: string;
  jsonText?: JsonTextMatch | JsonTextMatch[]; // jsonb columns only; cannot be combined with other operators in the same object.
};
type WherePrimitive = string | number | boolean | bigint | Date | null | undefined;
type WhereValue = WherePrimitive | WherePrimitive[] | WhereOperator;
```
